Gurpreet Banerjee | gurpreet.banerjee936@example.com | +91 9531487175
Secunderabad
Open to relocation anywhere in India. Notice period: 60 days

Professional Summary
Results-driven finance professional with progressive experience in accounting operations, statutory compliance, and vendor management. Proven track record of improving payables processes, ensuring GST and TDS compliance, and delivering timely month-end closes using Tally Prime and advanced Microsoft Excel techniques.

Technical Skills
Tally Prime, GST, TDS, Accounts Payable, Microsoft Excel, Git

Work Experience

Senior Accountant, Nykaa (Nov 2022 - Present)
- Managed end-to-end Accounts Payable lifecycle for a portfolio of 200+ vendors, improving invoice processing time by implementing standardized procedures in Tally Prime and Excel; ensured GST-compliant invoicing and timely credits.
- Prepared monthly GST returns, reconciled GSTR-2B with vendor invoices using Microsoft Excel pivots and lookup functions, and coordinated with vendors to resolve discrepancies, reducing GST mismatches by 35%.
- Processed TDS calculations and filings for vendor payments, maintained TDS schedules in Excel, and supported internal audits with detailed TDS supporting documents.
- Streamlined vendor payment runs and maintained payable aging reports in Tally Prime and Excel; collaborated with procurement and operations to prioritize critical payments.

Accounts Manager, CartNest (Feb 2013 - Oct 2022)
- Led Accounts Payable operations and vendor management for a fast-growing e-commerce services firm, implementing Tally Prime for transaction recording and month-end reconciliations.
- Automated recurring reports and cash flow forecasts using advanced Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, macros), improving payment planning and reducing late payment instances by 28%.
- Ensured accurate TDS deduction and quarterly filings, maintained TDS registers, and liaised with vendors to provide TDS certificates.
- Oversaw GST compliance, prepared GST reconciliations, and supported statutory audits by providing detailed workpapers and reconciled supplier statements.

Education
MBA (Finance), NMIMS
